question: A support message calls the change complete. Which is complete, the code fix or the customer rollout, and what remains unfinished?

claims.text: The PAY-102 code fix is complete (Done), but the customer rollout remains unfinished: only a controlled pilot is approved, general availability (GA) is not approved, and no general release date is confirmed.

supports.quote: PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
